s1.syndrome_frame: Chronic vision disturbance with signs of intraocular inflammation and macular edema
salient_findings: Cystoid macular edema with subfoveal fluid
Keratic precipitates and cells in the anterior chamber
key_facts: Blurry vision in right eye for several months
Anastrozole therapy for more than 2 years
Conjunctival injection and fine keratic precipitates in right eye
Cystoid macular edema with yellow spot in fovea in right eye
No peripheral inflammation in either eye
Normal blood tests for vasculitis and rheumatologic disorders

raw.syndrome_frame: Chronic vision disturbance with signs of intraocular inflammation and macular edema
salient_findings: Cystoid macular edema with subfoveal fluid
Keratic precipitates and cells in the anterior chamber
key_facts: Blurry vision in right eye for several months
Anastrozole therapy for more than 2 years
Conjunctival injection and fine keratic precipitates in right eye
Cystoid macular edema with yellow spot in fovea in right eye
No peripheral inflammation in either eye
Normal blood tests for vasculitis and rheumatologic disorders

differentials: Acute posterior multifocal placoid pigment epitheliopathy
Acute posterior multifocal placoid pigment epitheliopathy

shortlist.label: Fuchs heterochromic iridocyclitis
shortlist.why_kept: History of bilateral iritis and presence of fine keratic precipitates

shortlist.label: Toxoplasmosis
shortlist.why_kept: Cystoid macular edema and yellow spot in fovea, consistent with toxoplasmosis retinochoroiditis

shortlist.label: Sarcoidosis
shortlist.why_kept: Bilateral iritis and cystoid macular edema, with normal blood tests for vasculitis and rheumatologic disorders

shortlist.label: Vogt-Koyanagi-Harada disease
shortlist.why_kept: Chronic vision disturbance with signs of intraocular inflammation and macular edema

shortlist.label: Sympathetic ophthalmia
shortlist.why_kept: History of bilateral iritis and presence of fine keratic precipitates, with a possible link to previous ocular surgery

joint.why: it often presents with unilateral symptoms
Sarcoidosis is known to cause recurrent episodes of bilateral iritis

trace.fact: Cystoid macular edema with subfoveal fluid

joint.favored: Uveitis-related conditions such as Vogt-Koyanagi-Harada disease or Sympathetic ophthalmia
joint.why: Cystoid macular edema is common in uveitis

trace.fact: Keratic precipitates and cells in the anterior chamber

joint.why: Keratic precipitates and cells in the anterior chamber are characteristic of Fuchs heterochromic iridocyclitis
